p: jīng zōu lǔ jì kǒng zǐ ér tàn zhī
z: ㄐㄧㄥ ㄗㄡ ㄌㄨˇ ㄐㄧˋ ㄎㄨㄥˇ ㄗˇ ㄦˊ ㄊㄢˋ ㄓ
en: Passing through Lu to Sacrifice to Confucius and Offer Lament

t: 夫子何為者，棲棲一代中。
c: 夫子何为者，栖栖一代中。
p: fū zǐ hé wéi zhě, xī xī yī dài zhōng.
z: ㄈㄨ ㄗˇ ㄏㄜˊ ㄨㄟˊ ㄓㄜˇ，ㄒㄧ ㄒㄧ ㄧ ㄉㄞˋ ㄓㄨㄥ。
en: Master, what was it that you sought, rushing anxiously throughout your age?

t: 地猶鄹氏邑，宅即魯王宮。
c: 地犹鄹氏邑，宅即鲁王宫。
p: dì yóu zōu shì yì, zhái jí lǔ wáng gōng.
z: ㄉㄧˋ ㄧㄡˊ ㄗㄡ ㄕˋ ㄧˋ，ㄓㄞˊ ㄐㄧˊ ㄌㄨˇ ㄨㄤˊ ㄍㄨㄥ。
en: The land is still the town of the Zou clan, but your home has become the palace of the Prince of Lu.

t: 嘆鳳嗟身否，傷麟怨道窮。
c: 叹凤嗟身否，伤麟怨道穷。
p: tàn fèng jiē shēn pǐ, shāng lín yuàn dào qióng.
z: ㄊㄢˋ ㄈㄥˋ ㄐㄧㄝ ㄕㄣ ㄆㄧˇ，ㄕㄤ ㄌㄧㄣˊ ㄩㄢˋ ㄉㄠˋ ㄑㄩㄥˊ。
en: Sighing for the phoenix, you lamented your bad fortune; grieving for the unicorn, you resented that the Way had reached its end.

wg.en: sighing for the phoenix (symbol of missing opportunity)
grieving for the unicorn (symbol of sage appearing at wrong time)
the Way is exhausted / end of the road

t: 今看兩楹奠，當與夢時同。
c: 今看两楹奠，当与梦时同。
p: jīn kàn liǎng yíng diàn, dāng yǔ mèng shí tóng.
z: ㄐㄧㄣ ㄎㄢˋ ㄌㄧㄤˇ ㄧㄥˊ ㄉㄧㄢˋ，ㄉㄤ ㄩˇ ㄇㄥˋ ㄕˊ ㄊㄨㄥˊ。
en: Now looking at the sacrificial offerings between the two pillars, it must be just like the scene in your dream.

wg.en: time of the dream (Confucius dreamt of sitting between pillars before death)
